title: Greeting Count Basie's band at Roseland in 1936
summary: John had told them about Basie's Kansas City band before it came east; when it opened at Roseland, Stuff's group went over and played a couple of numbers as greeters.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: See, when we come in, Basie hadn't come to town yet, because John was coming in the place and he was telling us about this great band out in Kansas City, you know, that he'd heard.

Count Basie, you know, with Lester Young and Hershel Evans and Buck and all of them. And finally, when they come in, they opened them at the Roseland, and we went over as a greeter. We played a couple of numbers with the band, you know, with our group, you know.
At Roseland, yes. It's so long ago, now.
Had to be about '36, yeah, had to be
